facts.text: The New Mexico Opportunity Scholarship covers 100% of tuition and mandatory fees, plus course fees up to $50 per credit hour, for eligible New Mexico residents at UNM.

sources.title: New Mexico Opportunity Scholarship :: Scholarship Office | The University of New Mexico
sources.quote: Covers full tuition, mandatory fees and course fees up to $50/credit hour

sources.title: New Mexico Opportunity Scholarship :: Scholarship Office | The University of New Mexico
sources.quote: Any student deemed eligible is awarded the Opportunity Scholarship automatically beginning their first term at UNM.
